description: Get alert counts grouped by status: open, escalated, resolved, dismissed. Accepts every filter `list_alerts` does except `status` — the response buckets BY status — so passing the same filters to both makes the four counts sum to the `total` that `list_alerts` reports. Unfiltered, the counts cover the whole organization over all time. Use this to size a selection before calling `bulk_update_alert_status` with `all_matching`.

country_code.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, e.g. US,DE,JP.

date_from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive lower bound on alert creation.

date_to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive upper bound on alert creation.

policy_set_id.description: Comma-separated policy-set UUIDs. Matches alerts raised by any of them; see `list_policy_sets`.

tag.description: Comma-separated tag slugs. Matches alerts carrying any of them; see `list_tags`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin') the date bounds are read in. Defaults to UTC. Omitting both dates spans all time.

name: get_alert_stats
title: Get Alert Stats
